Command-line subcommands for running, monitoring, configuring, and managing Firedancer.

# Purpose
`fdctl` is the command-line interface for Firedancer validator management and system setup. It provides commands to start and monitor the validator, prepare and verify the host operating system, inspect version and metrics data, and manage validator identity and key files. The `configure` commands set kernel parameters, huge page mounts, and network device options that Firedancer needs before startup, while `mem` reports the memory and layout requirements that drive those settings. Other commands such as `set-identity`, `keys`, `version`, `shred-version`, and `metrics` support runtime administration and diagnostics for a running validator.
